cohort: The study included women with uncomplicated singleton, full-term pregnancies in vertex presentation, comparing those with type III FGM/C to those with type I/II FGM/C or no FGM/C.
finding: Women with type III FGM/C showed a greater frequency of postpartum hemorrhage and the use of mediolateral episiotomy.
mod_finding: Mediolateral episiotomy was associated with a reduced rate of spontaneous perineal laceration, including third-degree and fourth-degree lacerations, in women with type III FGM/C who underwent de-infibulation.
